title: astro-xai-bench: a quantitative benchmark for explainable AI in astronomical transient classification
description: Open benchmark and framework accompanying Pagliaro (2026), Astronomy & Astrophysics. It evaluates the quality of machine-learning explanations along five complementary axes — perturbation-based faithfulness, deletion/insertion AUC, complexity, cross-representation plausibility, and the model- and data-randomisation sanity checks of Adebayo et al. (2018) — for nine classifiers spanning tree-based, deep-learning and physics-informed architectures on the PLAsTiCC photometric transient dataset. Includes the evaluation pipelines, the expert feature mask, and scripts/recompute_plausibility.py, the reproducibility entry point for the plausibility results.
